blocks.text: Hydrogen ions (H⁺) ki maujoodgi mein hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) iodide ions (I⁻) se react kar ke pani aur iodine banata hai:
Is reaction ki rate equation yeh hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein rate equation fraction ki shakal mein chhapi hai: k[H₂O₂] / [I⁻]. Sahi rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻] hai (dono ke lihaz se first order); sirf yahi Table 7.2 ke numbers aur k ki unit dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ se milti hai.
Reaction ki progress iodine banne ki shuru wali (initial) rate naap kar dekhi ja sakti hai. Table 7.2 mein har reactant ki mukhtalif shuru ki concentrations par rates di gayi hain.
Experiment 1 ke data se k nikalne ka tareeqa:
Step 2 Equation ko k ke liye tarteeb dein (k ko akela ek taraf le aayein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Step 2 aur 3 bhi ghalat fraction se chalte hain (k = rate × [I⁻] / [H₂O₂]); un se 1.75 × 10⁻⁶ aata, 1.75 × 10⁻² nahi. Upar sahi hal hai, jis ka jawab kitab ke jawab 1.75 × 10⁻² dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ se milta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 7.2: Reactants ki concentration badalne ka rate par asar

blocks.text: Hydrogen ions ki concentration ko nazar-andaz kiya jata hai kyun ke [H⁺] rate equation mein nahi aata. Yani reaction [H⁺] ke lihaz se zero order hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Experiment 1 se 2 mein sirf [H₂O₂] 1.5 guna hua (0.0200 → 0.0300) aur rate bhi taqreeban 1.5 guna (3.5 → 5.3); is se H₂O₂ ka first order hona nazar aata hai.

blocks.prompt: 2HI → H₂ + I₂ ke teen experiments mein [HI] = 0.015, 0.030 aur 0.045 mol dm⁻³ par rates 1.1 × 10⁻³, 4.4 × 10⁻³ aur 9.9 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ thin. Rate law likhein aur k unit ke saath nikalein.
blocks.explanation: [HI] dugna karne par rate 4 guna aur tigna karne par 9 guna hoti hai, to rate [HI]² ke proportional hai: rate = k[HI]², second order. k = 1.1 × 10⁻³ / (0.015)² = 1.1 × 10⁻³ / 2.25 × 10⁻⁴ = 4.9 dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹.

items: [H⁺] rate equation mein nahi: reaction H⁺ ke lihaz se zero order hai.
